about.title: About BudgetBasics
about.description: BudgetBasics is an educational website designed to help students understand basic budgeting, saving, spending, and money management concepts.
purpose: Teach students the fundamentals of budgeting.
Build awareness about saving and financial goals.
Help students understand needs versus wants.
Help users identify and avoid common money mistakes.
Provide simple interactive budgeting tools and educational resources.
about.disclaimer: BudgetBasics is an educational project. The information and calculators are provided for learning purposes and are not professional financial advice.
